event: Nala holds very still and strains to hear the low voices beyond the walls.
Three voices: her mother's, close and soft; a man's and a woman's, farther off and duller.
The man does most of the talking, slow and pleased; the woman cuts in short now and then.
Not one word is English; the sounds run together in a tongue she has never heard.
One word comes back again and again, the same two sounds each time: kerith.
The rest slips past her; she gets the shape and mood of the talk, never its sense.
Window: New Path - Path of Eavesdropping.

event: Her mother says something soft; the man laughs, and the woman says kerith again.
A heavy hand presses on the wall beside her: the man's, laid flat on her mother's belly.
The talk stops. All three fall quiet, the hand still pressing, as if waiting on her.
